subject: Premium students average half a letter grade higher
body_paragraphs: I ran the numbers last month across our 4,000+ Premium users. Compared to free users, Premium students average half a letter grade higher on the papers they submit. That's a B+ becoming an A-, or an A- becoming an A. Across an entire semester, that's a real GPA shift.

Why the gap? Three things. First, unlimited essays — the free tier caps at 3 generations per month, which forces compromises by the third paper. Second, Humanize bypasses AI detection so you can use AI-assisted work without anxiety. Third, the Pro Citation engine handles APA, MLA, and Chicago without manual fixes. Together, those three add up to better grades and far less stress.

Premium is the price of two coffees per month. Half a letter grade across a transcript is worth way more than that — graduate school applications, scholarship eligibility, GPA recovery. Most Premium students tell me they wish they'd subscribed at the start of the semester instead of midway through.

7-day free trial, cancel anytime, no card charged until day 8. P.S. Premium also includes unlimited 'Outline to Full Paper' generations — turn a bullet list into a complete essay in 30 seconds. That alone is worth the subscription.
